description: Lightweight transactions (Paxos) per node: CAS latency, throughput, errors, contention, unfinished commits, condition-not-met, linearizability violations, replica-side Paxos phase latency, MutationStage pressure and Paxos dropped messages, with regular QUORUM latency beside CAS latency.

panels.title: CAS latency — what the client waits for

panels.description: Coordinator-side latency of CAS writes (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE ... IF), per node. Read from scope=CASWrite. Pre-aggregated per-node percentiles; never averaged across nodes.
panels.title: CAS Write Latency — p50 / p99 / p999 (${latency_unit:text})

panels.description: Coordinator-side latency of SERIAL and LOCAL_SERIAL reads, per node. Read from scope=CASRead. Cassandra also records these reads in scope=Read.
panels.title: CAS Read Latency — p50 / p99 / p999 (${latency_unit:text})

panels.description: CAS requests per second coordinated by each node, by operation.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (cluster, host_name, cassandra_operation) (rate(cassandra_client_request_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job="cassandra", host_name=~"$host", cassandra_operation=~"caswrite|casread"}[$__rate_interval])), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+-[0-9a-f]{8})-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}")

panels.title: CAS Throughput

panels.description: CAS request errors per second, by operation and status. A CAS timeout leaves the outcome unknown to the client.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (cluster, host_name, cassandra_operation, cassandra_status) (rate(cassandra_client_request_error_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job="cassandra", host_name=~"$host", cassandra_operation=~"caswrite|casread"}[$__rate_interval])), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+-[0-9a-f]{8})-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}")

panels.title: CAS Timeouts, Unavailables and Failures

panels.description: CAS writes per second whose IF condition did not match the current row, so nothing was written. Read from scope=CASWrite only.
panels.title: Condition Not Met Rate

panels.description: Times per second a CAS request found an accepted but uncommitted proposal from an earlier round and had to finish it first. A rise means earlier rounds are being interrupted, often by timeouts or contention.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (cluster, host_name, cassandra_operation) (rate(cassandra_client_request_cas_unfinished_commits_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job="cassandra", host_name=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval])), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+-[0-9a-f]{8})-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}")

panels.title: Unfinished Commit Rate

panels.description: Paxos attempts a CAS request lost to a competing ballot before it succeeded. Cassandra records only requests that lost at least one attempt, so these percentiles describe contended requests only.
panels.title: Contention per Contended Request — p50 / p99 / max

panels.description: CAS requests per second that lost at least one Paxos attempt to contention, by operation. Compare with CAS Throughput to see the contended share.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (cluster, host_name, cassandra_operation) (rate(cassandra_client_request_cas_contended_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job="cassandra", host_name=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval])), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+-[0-9a-f]{8})-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}")

panels.title: Contended Request Rate

panels.description: Paxos linearizability violations detected across the dashboard time range, per cluster. Any value above zero is a correctness bug; the Cassandra log has a "Linearizability violation" line with the details.
panels.title: Linearizability Violations over the selected range

panels.description: Linearizability violations each node has detected since it started. The line must stay flat at zero.
panels.title: Linearizability Violations Total
Replica side Paxos phases — slowest tables

panels.description: Replica-side Paxos prepare latency per table (type=Table,name=CasPrepareLatency), the ten highest per cluster. Tables with no LWT traffic report zero and are left out.
panels.title: CasPrepare Latency ${percentile} — top 10 (${latency_unit:text})

panels.description: Replica-side Paxos propose latency per table (type=Table,name=CasProposeLatency), the ten highest per cluster. Tables with no LWT traffic report zero and are left out.
panels.title: CasPropose Latency ${percentile} — top 10 (${latency_unit:text})

panels.description: Replica-side Paxos commit latency per table (type=Table,name=CasCommitLatency), the ten highest per cluster. Tables with no LWT traffic report zero and are left out.
panels.title: CasCommit Latency ${percentile} — top 10 (${latency_unit:text})

panels.description: Tasks queued on MutationStage. Every PAXOS2 prepare, propose and commit request runs on this stage, beside regular writes.
panels.title: MutationStage Pending

panels.description: Paxos messages dropped per second, by verb. Covers the PAXOS2_* verbs of paxos_variant v2 and the PAXOS_* verbs of v1. A dropped Paxos message costs the coordinator a retry or a timeout.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (cluster, host_name, message_type) (rate(cassandra_messages_dropped_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job="cassandra", host_name=~"$host", message_type=~"PAXOS.*"}[$__rate_interval])), "cluster_name", "$1", "cluster", "(.+-[0-9a-f]{8})-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}")

panels.title: Paxos Dropped Messages

panels.description: Read-QUORUM is regular read latency without serial reads. Plain Read includes serial reads, so it sits between the two when both run.
panels.title: Read p99 — QUORUM vs SERIAL (${latency_unit:text})

panels.description: Write-QUORUM is regular write latency at QUORUM. CAS writes are recorded only under CASWrite and Write-SERIAL or Write-LOCAL_SERIAL, never under Write.
panels.title: Write p99 — QUORUM vs CAS (${latency_unit:text})

list.label: Percentile
list.name: percentile

list.description: Display unit for latency. The metric is emitted in microseconds, so the value is the divisor: milliseconds divides by 1000, microseconds divides by 1.
list.label: Latency unit
list.name: latency_unit
